prompt: A teammate drafts a script and includes the line `git pull-request`. It fails. Why?
explanation: Git handles local version control; the pull request — proposing a merge, collecting review, hosting the discussion — lives on GitHub. There is no `git pull-request` subcommand in Git itself.

options.text: A pull request is a GitHub collaboration feature, not a Git command
The command exists but needs the `--web` flag
Pull requests only work from GitHub Desktop
Git commands must run inside a pull request
